_about: What each garment is made of and how it measures, from the maker's own spec sheets (SanMar, the supplier the print vendor buys from). Measurements are inches, laid flat. 'fitsChest' is the wearer's chest measurement the maker gives for each size. Keyed by product id in catalog.json.

adult-tee.fit: Classic unisex fit, true to size
features: Tear-away label, so nothing scratches your neck
adult-tee.care: Machine wash cold, inside out with like colors. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry medium, medium or hot iron. Do not iron the print.

adult-hoodie.maker: Port & Company Core Fleece Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt
adult-hoodie.fit: Classic unisex fit, true to size
adult-hoodie.care: Machine wash cold, inside out with like colors. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry low. Do not iron.

kids-tee.maker: Port & Company Youth Core Cotton Tee
kids-tee.fit: Classic youth fit. Sizes run by age range, so check the chest numbers
features: Same shirt as the adult tee, sized for kids
kids-tee.care: Machine wash cold, inside out with like colors. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry medium, medium or hot iron. Do not iron the print.

kids-hoodie.maker: Port & Company Youth Core Fleece Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt
kids-hoodie.fit: Classic youth fit. Sizes run by age range, so check the chest numbers
features: Hood with no drawcord, for kids' safety
kids-hoodie.care: Machine wash cold, inside out with like colors. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry medium, medium or hot iron. Do not iron the print.
